outline:
Course Description
Theory and practice of Augmented Reality (AR)/ Virtual Reality (VR). Provides in-depth overview of AR/VR, including geometry and physics of virtual worlds, visual rendering, visual perception, pose tracking, interaction hardware, audio and haptics, locomotion, selection and manipulation, and robotic interfaces.

Student Learning Objectives/Outcomes
• Ability to setup 3D virtual environments
• Ability to play VR in 3D virtual environments
• Ability to evaluate 3D virtual environments
• Ability to develop 3D virtual environments
• Ability to render 3D virtual worlds into images
• Ability to understand human visual system and visual perception
• Ability to understand audio and haptics
• Ability to utilize head tracking, eye tracking and pose tracking techniques
• Ability to utilize locomotion, 3D selection and manipulation techniques
